items.name: setGame

parameters.name: gameObj
parameters.description: Game object containing update(dt) and draw() functions

items.description: Sets the game object and starts the engine. The game object must contain update(dt) and draw() functions.

items.name: fps
items.description: Sets the target frame rate for the game loop.

items.name: getCanvasSize
items.description: Returns the canvas dimensions as { width, height } in pixels (including devicePixelRatio).

items.name: requestFullscreen
items.description: Requests fullscreen mode for the canvas element. Cross-browser compatible.

items.name: setFullscreenCallback

parameters.name: callback
parameters.description: Function to call when fullscreen state changes

items.description: Sets a callback function that is invoked when the fullscreen state changes.

items.name: hasTabSwitched

parameters.name: reset
parameters.description: If false, resets the tab switch flag to false

items.description: Returns true if the user has switched away from the browser tab. Automatically mutes audio when tab is hidden and clears input state when returning.

items.name: unload

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: Path to the image or BGM audio file to unload

items.description: Unloads an image texture or BGM audio file from memory. Throws error if resource not found or if attempting to unload SFX.

items.name: rect
items.description: Draws a colored rectangle with optional rotation, scale, and alpha. Supports '#rrggbb' or '#rrggbbaa' color format.

items.name: image

parameters.name: cropEndX
parameters.description: Crop end X coordinate (default: image width)

parameters.name: cropEndY
parameters.description: Crop end Y coordinate (default: image height)

items.description: Draws a preloaded image with optional rotation, scale, alpha, and cropping. If image is not yet loaded, it will be drawn asynchronously when ready.

items.name: key
items.description: Returns true if the specified key is currently pressed. Supports key names like 'space', 'enter', 'esc', arrow keys, and digits 0-9.

items.name: mouse
items.description: Mouse input object with position properties and button state checking.

members.name: x
members.description: Current mouse X position in canvas coordinates

members.name: y
members.description: Current mouse Y position in canvas coordinates

members.name: down
members.description: Returns true if the specified mouse button is currently pressed

items.name: touch
items.description: Touch input object supporting up to 4 simultaneous touches with finger IDs 0-3.

members.name: exists
members.description: Returns true if a finger is currently touching at the specified ID slot

members.name: down
members.description: Returns true if a finger is currently pressed at the specified ID slot

members.name: x
members.description: Returns the X position of the finger at the specified ID slot

members.name: y
members.description: Returns the Y position of the finger at the specified ID slot

items.name: audio
items.description: Audio control object for managing SFX and BGM playback with volume and mute controls.

members.name: play

parameters.name: loop
parameters.description: Whether BGM should loop (default: true, ignored for SFX)

members.description: Plays an SFX sound or BGM music. SFX can be played simultaneously, BGM stops previous BGM when called.

members.name: stop

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Audio type: 'sfx', 'bgm', or omit for both

members.description: Stops SFX, BGM, or both. Omit type parameter to stop all audio.

items.name: preload

parameters.name: resources
parameters.description: Single path string, array of paths, or array of objects with 'images', 'audio', 'path' properties

items.description: Preloads images and audio files before game starts. Supports string, array of strings, or array of objects with 'images', 'audio', 'path' keys.

items.name: checkpreload

parameters.name: reset
parameters.description: If false, resets preload state to false

items.description: Returns true if all preloaded resources have finished loading. Pass false to reset preload state.

items.name: preloadfailed
items.description: Returns true if any resource failed to preload during the last preload() call.

items.name: TEMF.cleanupTextures
items.description: Deletes all cached textures from GPU memory and clears the texture cache.

items.name: TEMF.cleanupAudio
items.description: Stops all audio playback, clears audio cache, and closes the AudioContext.
